output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated as the value of the buy price divided by the balance of the user.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated as the balance of the user multiplied by the sell price.
The freezeAccount function has an integer overflow where the argument 'freeze' is used to determine if an arbitrary user should be frozen or not, which can be misused for malicious intent.
